name: Rahul Sharma
title: VP of Engineering
bio: Leads a 90-person platform engineering organization at Acme Technologies. Technical, detail-oriented, with deep distributed systems experience. Cares intensely about p99 latency, predictability, and minimal operational toil for his SRE team.

preferences.text: Prefers crisp bulleted summaries over dense slide decks.
preferences.context: Stated explicitly in Meeting #1 and reiterated in Meeting #4.

preferences.text: Strictly avoids Friday afternoon syncs; needs agenda 24h prior.
preferences.context: Blocked calendar repeatedly on Fridays; requests calendar invites with clear agenda bullets.

preferences.text: Wants exact CLI snippets and Terraform configurations, not high-level marketing claims.
preferences.context: Prefers code snippets and reproducible benchmarks from your engineering team.

preferences.text: Begins meetings by reviewing unresolved commitments from the previous session.

knownConcerns.topic: p99 Latency Spikes during Peak Traffic
knownConcerns.description: Anxious that database schema transitions could cause latency to breach 150ms SLA between 14:00-16:00 EST.

knownConcerns.topic: CFO Budget Cap on Enterprise Licensing
knownConcerns.description: CFO is scrutinizing cloud infra expenditures; Rahul needs solid ROI math on node efficiency to justify contract expansion.
Previously resisted proprietary binary wire formats; insists on standard OpenTelemetry and gRPC compatibility.

name: Sarah Chen
title: Head of Product
bio: Drives product discovery and platform integrations for NexaFlow. Focused on developer onboarding velocity and UI configurability.

preferences.text: Appreciates interactive prototypes and Figma walkthroughs.

knownConcerns.description: Worries that non-technical managers might struggle with complex workflow setups.

name: Marcus Vance
title: CTO & Co-founder
bio: Former DeepMind research lead now building real-time autonomous data ingestion pipelines. Moving fast, wants beta access to experimental features.

preferences.text: Wants early access to raw Python SDKs and OpenAPI specs before public release.
preferences.context: Iterates fast and provides detailed PR feedback.

knownConcerns.description: High throughput pipeline requires bursting to 5,000 queries per second without throttling.
